body: Trying to remove it leads to additional includes in around 7 other files, which I feel like adds extra noise to current PR

`get_validated_object` has a type check inside it that will return nullptr if the type doesn't match and `Object::cast_to` has a null check in it, and it also uses the same `obj && obj->is_class_ptr`, but looks nicer. `was_freed` is not used, so it is removed
`_profile_count_as_native` has a null check in it, so it is safe to call `base_obj->get_class_name()` here
